Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.GameModel
public class GameModel extends Object
The GameModel class represents the state and behavior of the game. It handles player management, tile and card pile allocation, deck generation, and game state transitions. This class is responsible for most of the server-side game logic, including score computation, board setup, and in-game player actions.

    • flipTimer

      public void flipTimer(boolean hasPlayerFinished)
      Flips the building timer if allowed. If the player hasn't finished building and there are still flips available, starts the timer. Otherwise, does nothing.

      This method is synchronized to prevent race conditions during timer manipulation.

      Parameters:
      hasPlayerFinished - indicates whether the player has finished building.

    • claimPosition

      public void claimPosition(Player player, int positionIndex)
      Allows a player to claim a position once they are done building their ship. Updates their state and removes the position from the available pool. If all positions are claimed, progresses the game to the correcting phase.
      Parameters:
      player - the player claiming a position.
      positionIndex - the index of the position to claim.

    • removeSelectedTile

      public void removeSelectedTile(Player player, int x, int y)
      Removes a selected tile from the player's ship board during the correcting phase. If all invalid tiles are corrected for all players, advances to the crew assignment phase.
      Parameters:
      player - the player making the correction.
      x - the x-coordinate of the tile to remove.
      y - the y-coordinate of the tile to remove.
